summary: QIAGEN N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing materials related to its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 24, 2026. The exhibits include the notice, proxy statement, attendance forms, proxy card, voting results, and annual reports. This is a routine reporting of corporate governance and meeting materials, with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendations on M&A, or unusual corporate actions. It is a periodic disclosure of standard shareholder meeting documentation for a foreign private issuer.
